data.narrative:
Eikon Therapeutics is a Series B-stage biotech company founded by Luke Lavis, Eric Betzig, Robert Tjian, and Xavier Darzacq. The target currently carries a post-money valuation of $539M on $1.1B+ total raised. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 3 public biotech firms (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage peers in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implying a valuation of $1.0B from the $539M base. Peer-median anchoring uses 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B), yielding a median of $3.8B with a range of $3.1B–$10.3B. Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of target revenue data, which private companies typically do not disclose. The sector median P/S for public biotech stands at 8.1x.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $870M–$4.4B, with a median of $2.4B. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion in peer valuations (3.3x spread from min to max), reliance on only two methodologies, and the absence of revenue-based anchoring. The current $539M valuation sits below the methodological low, warranting examination of stage-specific financing conditions and recent revenue inflection.
